page.name: tokens_config

field.name: access_token_timeout_hours
field.help: How long an OAuth access token is valid after it is issued. After this period, the AI client must exchange its refresh token for a new access token. Default: 24 hours.

field.name: refresh_token_timeout_days
field.help: How long the refresh token remains valid. After this period, the user must go through the full OAuth consent flow again. Only applies when 'offline_access' scope is granted. Default: 30 days.

page.div: Bearer tokens (API Keys) created manually in the API Tokens tab do not have a forced expiry by default. Set an Expiry Date on individual token records to rotate them automatically.

page.name: limits
page.div: These limits prevent runaway AI scripts from consuming excessive server resources or extracting too much data in a single call.

field.name: code_execute_limit
field.help: Maximum lines of Python code allowed in a single odoo_execute_orm call. Prevents runaway code. Default: 10000.

field.name: code_search_limit
field.help: Maximum results returned by odoo_code_search per call. Prevents AI from extracting your entire codebase. Default: 5000.

field.name: expose_echart_data_in_response
field.string: Return Live Chart Data to AI
field.help: If ON, live Odoo data fetched for EChart dashboards is included in the MCP tool response, allowing AI to verify chart accuracy. If OFF, data stays on the server — only the chart configuration is returned. Disable for sensitive data environments.

page.name: logging
page.div: Every MCP tool call is logged with timing, user, tool name, and status. View logs via MCP Studio → Execution Logs.

field.name: log_retention_days
field.help: Execution logs older than this many days are deleted by a daily scheduled job. Set 0 to keep logs forever (not recommended for production). Default: 90 days.

field.name: log_full_payload
field.help: When ON, the complete JSON input and output for every tool call is stored in the log record. Useful for debugging AI agent behavior, but may expose sensitive data. Turn OFF after debugging. Default: OFF.

page.div: Full Payload Logging is ON. Tool inputs and outputs — which may contain passwords, tokens, and customer data — are stored in every log record. Turn this OFF after debugging is complete.

div.p: Strip or mask sensitive fields before AI receives data.

ul.li: Layer 1 — Authentication: OAuth 2.1 + PKCE or Bearer token required on every request.
Layer 2 — Tool Access: Read auto-allowed. Write/Execute require explicit tool allowlist membership.
Layer 3 — Model Restrictions: Block entire Odoo models per user group.
Layer 4 — Field Restrictions: Strip or mask individual fields before AI sees the data.
Layer 5 — Odoo ACLs: Native ir.model.access rules always enforced underneath MCP.

page.name: ip
page.div: Evaluation order: Blacklist is checked first. If the IP matches, access is denied. Whitelist is checked next — if set and the IP is not listed, access is denied too. Both empty = all IPs allowed.

field.name: ip_blacklist
field.help: IP addresses or CIDR ranges unconditionally blocked from all MCP endpoints. Takes priority over whitelist.

group.string: IP Whitelist — leave empty to allow all IPs

field.name: ip_whitelist
field.help: If set, only IPs in this list can access MCP. Leave empty to allow all IPs. Common use: restrict to your office or VPN CIDR range.

page.name: rate
page.div: Rate limiting is applied per Odoo user per minute. AI agent loops that call tools rapidly will receive a rate-limit error and are expected to back off and retry.

field.name: rate_limit_enabled
field.help: When ON, tool calls exceeding the per-minute limit return an error. The AI client should retry with exponential backoff.

field.name: rate_limit_per_minute
field.help: Maximum odoo_tool_call requests per user per minute. Requests beyond this are rejected. Default: 60. Set lower for stricter control.

page.name: data

field.name: mask_sensitive_in_logs
field.string: Mask Restricted Fields in Audit Logs
field.help: When ON, fields marked as 'restricted' in Model Restriction Groups appear as [RESTRICTED] in audit logs instead of showing the real value. Protects sensitive data (passwords, salaries, tokens) from appearing in log records.

page.div: Field restrictions only affect MCP access. Odoo web UI users retain their normal field permissions regardless of MCP field restriction settings.

page.name: oauth
page.p: AI agents that connected via OAuth 2.1 appear here. Each record represents one AI client application that completed the consent flow. Deactivate a record to revoke that client's access immediately.

page.name: tokens
page.p: Bearer tokens for Authorization: Bearer YOUR_TOKEN or X-MCP-API-Key header authentication. Each token authenticates as one Odoo user. Deactivate a record to revoke access immediately. Rows in red are expired.

ol.li: Install this module on Odoo 19.
Assign MCP Admin to yourself, MCP User to team members (Settings → Users → Groups).
Create an API Token (API Tokens tab above) or connect via OAuth 2.1 from a web AI client.
Configure Tool Allowlists (Tool Rules button above) to unlock Write and Execute tools for your users.
Follow the Connection tab instructions for your specific AI client.
Test: Ask your AI — "List all Odoo models available to me."
